text:
anita: quick q - i forgot a floating holiday and need the morning off next fri for a community observance. can i take a half-day and still cover the release? cc @jake
mina: short answer: yes if manager signs off. long answer: submit the request, choose 'half-day' and pick which bucket (floating vs PTO). if within blackout window we need manager + people-ops approve.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: payroll cutoff for time-off edits is 3 business days before pay period end. see https://hr.redwood.com/timeoff :calendar:
jake: i can take morning coverage. @anita update the release notes and ping me 24h before. I'll approve in the portal when you submit.
anita: submitted as "half-day - floating holiday" and added a ~10 line handoff in the release doc. asked to preserve PTO carryover.
luis: small policy q - do half-days count as full-day consumption of floating holiday or prorated? manager said different things.
sara: policy excerpt: "Floating holidays are applied on a per-day basis; partial-day requests consume the corresponding portion of the selected bucket (e.g., half-day uses 0.5 of a day)." full policy: <https://hr.redwood.com/policies/holidays>.
mina: yep, half-day will deduct 0.5 from floating if you selected that bucket. if you accidentally chose PTO we can change it until payroll cutoff.
anita: thanks all. request shows pending manager approval. @jake let me know when you approve so people-ops can finalize before cutoff.
people-ops-bot: people-ops notification: request 2812345678-1 pending manager approval.
jake: approved in portal. confirmed coverage.
mina: i fast-tracked the backend flag to mark this as religious observance and preserved carryover. payroll will see floating -0.5. enjoy the observance! :sun_with_face:
anita: really appreciate it, thanks everyone :heart:
